QuestionStmt.S: The closed and open organ pipe have same length and when they are vibrating simultaneously in first overtone produce 3 beats. The length of open pipe is made $\left( \frac{1}{3} \right)^{\text{rd}}$ and that of closed pipe is made 3 times the original, the number of beats produced will be (Neglect end correction)

Solution.S:
For open pipe first overtone: $n_1 = \frac{v}{L}$.
For closed pipe first overtone: $n_1' = \frac{3v}{4L}$.

Beats: $n_1 - n_1' = \frac{v}{L} - \frac{3v}{4L} = \frac{v}{4L} = 3 \Rightarrow \frac{v}{L} = 12$.

When open pipe length becomes $\frac{L}{3}$, fundamental frequency: $n = \frac{v}{2(L/3)} = \frac{3v}{2L}$.

When closed pipe length becomes $3L$, fundamental frequency: $n' = \frac{v}{4(3L)} = \frac{v}{12L}$.

Beats = $n - n' = \frac{3v}{2L} - \frac{v}{12L} = \frac{18v}{12L} - \frac{v}{12L} = \frac{17v}{12L} = \frac{17}{12} \times 12 = 17$.

Thus the correct option is B: 17.
